_about: Decisoes tipadas do dia a dia de desenvolvimento, pareadas PT/EN. Cada pergunta tem os criterios em ingles (modo mais preciso medido em SPEC-RESEARCH.md) e casos rotulados a mao. Consumido por tests/test_dev_decisions.py.

commit_type.instructions: What kind of change is described?

criteria.feat: adds a new capability or behaviour visible to users
criteria.fix: corrects a bug or wrong behaviour
criteria.docs: changes only documentation, readme or comments
criteria.test: adds or changes only automated tests

cases.label: feat
cases.pt: Adiciona exportacao do relatorio de vendas em CSV na tela de pedidos.
cases.en: Add CSV export of the sales report to the orders screen.

cases.label: fix
cases.pt: Corrige calculo do ICMS que arredondava para baixo em pedidos com desconto.
cases.en: Fix ICMS calculation that rounded down on orders with a discount.

cases.label: refactor
cases.pt: Extrai a logica de frete do controller para um service, sem alterar o comportamento.
cases.en: Extract shipping logic from the controller into a service, with no behaviour change.

cases.label: docs
cases.pt: Atualiza o README com o passo a passo de instalacao local.
cases.en: Update the README with the local setup walkthrough.

cases.label: test
cases.pt: Cria testes unitarios para o calculo de comissao dos vendedores.
cases.en: Add unit tests for the sales commission calculation.

cases.label: chore
cases.pt: Atualiza cakephp/cakephp de 4.4 para 4.5 no composer.
cases.en: Bump cakephp/cakephp from 4.4 to 4.5 in composer.

cases.label: fix
cases.pt: Tela de clientes quebrava com erro 500 quando o CPF vinha vazio.
cases.en: Customers screen crashed with a 500 error when the CPF was empty.

cases.label: feat
cases.pt: Permite ao usuario agendar o envio automatico da nota fiscal por e-mail.
cases.en: Let users schedule automatic e-mailing of the invoice.

issue_kind.instructions: What kind of issue is this?

criteria.bug: something that used to work or should work is broken
criteria.feature: a request for new behaviour that does not exist yet
criteria.question: the reporter is asking how something works, nothing is broken
criteria.tech_debt: internal cleanup, upgrade or refactoring with no user-visible change

cases.label: bug
cases.pt: Desde ontem o botao salvar do cadastro de produtos nao faz nada.
cases.en: Since yesterday the save button on the product form does nothing.

cases.label: feature
cases.pt: Seria otimo poder filtrar os pedidos por transportadora.
cases.en: It would be great to filter orders by carrier.

cases.label: question
cases.pt: Como faco para cadastrar um segundo endereco de entrega para o cliente?
cases.en: How do I register a second delivery address for a customer?

cases.label: tech_debt
cases.pt: Precisamos migrar os jobs de cron para filas, o codigo atual esta duplicado.
cases.en: We need to move the cron jobs to queues; the current code is duplicated.

cases.label: bug
cases.pt: O total do pedido aparece diferente na tela e no PDF.
cases.en: The order total shows differently on screen and in the PDF.

cases.label: feature
cases.pt: Queremos um painel com o faturamento diario por vendedor.
cases.en: We want a dashboard with daily revenue per salesperson.

cases.label: question
cases.pt: Qual a diferenca entre pedido faturado e pedido expedido no sistema?
cases.en: What is the difference between an invoiced order and a shipped order in the system?

cases.label: tech_debt
cases.pt: Remover as classes antigas de integracao que ninguem mais usa.
cases.en: Remove the old integration classes nobody uses anymore.

test_failure_cause.instructions: What most likely caused this test failure?

criteria.product_bug: the code under test returns a wrong value or wrong behaviour
criteria.flaky: timing, race condition or random order; passes on retry
criteria.environment: missing service, database, network, credentials or configuration
criteria.outdated_test: the behaviour changed on purpose and the test expectation is old

cases.label: product_bug
cases.pt: Esperado 150.00, recebido 135.00 em testCalculaTotalComDesconto; o desconto esta sendo aplicado duas vezes.
cases.en: Expected 150.00, got 135.00 in testTotalWithDiscount; the discount is applied twice.

cases.label: flaky
cases.pt: O teste passa localmente e falha as vezes no CI por timeout esperando o elemento aparecer; rodando de novo passou.
cases.en: Test passes locally and sometimes fails in CI with a timeout waiting for the element; rerunning passed.

cases.label: environment
cases.pt: SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] Connection refused ao conectar no banco de testes.
cases.en: SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] Connection refused when connecting to the test database.

cases.label: outdated_test
cases.pt: O teste espera a mensagem 'Pedido salvo', mas o texto foi trocado de proposito para 'Pedido registrado' na ultima sprint.
cases.en: The test expects the message 'Order saved', but the text was deliberately changed to 'Order recorded' last sprint.

cases.label: environment
cases.pt: Falha ao chamar a API externa: variavel TRAY_CONSUMER_KEY nao definida no ambiente de CI.
cases.en: Failed calling the external API: TRAY_CONSUMER_KEY is not set in the CI environment.

cases.label: product_bug
cases.pt: Estoque ficou negativo apos cancelar o pedido; o teste esperava que voltasse para 10.
cases.en: Stock went negative after cancelling the order; the test expected it back at 10.

cases.label: flaky
cases.pt: Dois testes gravam no mesmo arquivo temporario e falham dependendo da ordem de execucao.
cases.en: Two tests write the same temp file and fail depending on execution order.

cases.label: outdated_test
cases.pt: Campo 'telefone' virou opcional pela nova regra, mas o teste ainda exige erro de validacao quando vazio.
cases.en: The 'phone' field became optional under the new rule, but the test still requires a validation error when empty.

log_severity.instructions: How severe is this log entry for the on-call engineer?

criteria.warning: degraded or unusual but the system still works
criteria.error: one operation failed, users may be affected
criteria.critical: outage, data loss or security breach; act now

cases.label: info
cases.pt: Job de sincronizacao de estoque concluido: 120 produtos atualizados em 3.2s.
cases.en: Stock sync job finished: 120 products updated in 3.2s.

cases.label: warning
cases.pt: Cota da API em 85%; reduzindo frequencia de sincronizacao.
cases.en: API quota at 85%; lowering sync frequency.

cases.label: error
cases.pt: Falha ao emitir NF-e do pedido 4521: rejeicao 539 duplicidade.
cases.en: Failed to issue NF-e for order 4521: rejection 539 duplicate.

cases.label: critical
cases.pt: Banco de producao sem espaco em disco; todas as gravacoes estao falhando.
cases.en: Production database out of disk space; all writes are failing.

cases.label: info
cases.pt: Usuario admin fez login com sucesso.
cases.en: User admin logged in successfully.

cases.label: warning
cases.pt: Consulta lenta: 4.8s em SELECT de pedidos sem indice.
cases.en: Slow query: 4.8s on orders SELECT without an index.

cases.label: error
cases.pt: Excecao nao tratada em PedidosController::edit, usuario recebeu erro 500.
cases.en: Unhandled exception in OrdersController::edit, user got a 500 error.

cases.label: critical
cases.pt: Detectado acesso a tabela de clientes com token vazado; dados pessoais exportados.
cases.en: Access to the customers table with a leaked token detected; personal data exported.

review_verdict.instructions: What verdict does this code review comment give?

criteria.approve: the reviewer is satisfied and the change can merge
criteria.request_changes: the reviewer blocks the merge until something is fixed
criteria.comment: a suggestion or question that does not block the merge

cases.label: approve
cases.pt: Tudo certo, testes passando. Pode mergear.
cases.en: All good, tests passing. Ship it.

cases.label: request_changes
cases.pt: Essa query concatena o input do usuario direto no SQL, precisa corrigir antes de subir.
cases.en: This query concatenates user input straight into SQL; must be fixed before merging.

cases.label: comment
cases.pt: Nit: talvez um nome mais descritivo para essa variavel, mas fica a seu criterio.
cases.en: Nit: maybe a more descriptive name for this variable, up to you.

cases.label: approve
cases.pt: Revisado, logica correta e bem coberta. Aprovado.
cases.en: Reviewed, logic is correct and well covered. Approved.

cases.label: request_changes
cases.pt: Faltou o teste do caso de cancelamento e a migracao quebra o banco atual. Bloqueando.
cases.en: The cancellation test is missing and the schema change breaks the current database. Blocking.

cases.label: comment
cases.pt: Por curiosidade, por que usar array aqui em vez de collection?
cases.en: Out of curiosity, why an array here instead of a collection?

breaking_change.instructions: Does this change break existing callers, clients or stored data?

cases.pt: Adiciona um campo opcional 'observacao' na resposta do pedido.
cases.en: Add an optional 'observacao' field to the order response.

cases.pt: Melhora o texto da mensagem de erro de login.

cases.pt: Cria um indice novo em pedidos(created) para acelerar o relatorio.
cases.en: Create a new index on orders(created) to speed up the report.
